headline: Amend city fee notice rule by removing newspaper publication requirement, CC#2026-018.
summary: The committee will consider CC#2026-018 (Gross), which would amend Chapter 2 'Administration,' Article 2 'City Council,' Section 28 'Fees' by deleting the requirement that fee changes or new fees be published in a local newspaper.
items: CC#2026-018 (Gross): Amend Ch. 2 'Administration,' Art. 2 'City Council,' Sec. 28 'Fees' by deleting 'and published in a local newspaper whenever fee changes or new fees are approved by the City Council.'
location: 1st Floor Council Conference Room, City Hall, 9 Dale Avenue, Gloucester, MA 01930
